snippet.title: To-Fu: The Trials of Chi - Now on Android
snippet.description:
Download Now on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.devolverdigital.tofu

Join our stretchy protagonist as he gets ready to undertake the infamous 'Trials of Chi'. Stretch, ping, stick and rebound our little hero through 150 levels of treacherous booby-traps and mystical mechanisms as you try to conquer the trials and help To-Fu become the illustrious Master of Chi.
